limitations: DumpGPU captures RDG-visible resources only. Resources never referenced by an RDG pass, memoryless resources, writable SkipTracking resources, and shader-local registers are not part of the raw frame; the capture summary records explicit absent/unsupported branches.
The bridge can issue several scene graphs per engine frame. The actual camera is identified from the dumped ViewData.PrimaryViews matrices and ViewRect, not from the bridge call count.
Shader-local choices inside a pixel/thread are not DumpGPU resources; they are recorded as gaps, never as invented parameter values.

expected.filmback: CameraActor FOV, no physical filmback; constraint off
expected.pilot_method: LevelEditorSubsystem.pilot_level_actor + exact camera view + allows cinematic control on the active level viewport; ViewFOV read back from the same viewport
